title: Ethical AI in the Healthcare Sector: Investigating Key Drivers of Adoption through the Multi-Dimensional Ethical AI Adoption Model (MEAAM)
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and empirical validation of the Multi-Dimensional Ethical AI Adoption Model (MEAAM), which categorizes and evaluates 13 critical ethical variables—such as justice, fairness, autonomy, beneficence, and moral obligations—as key drivers for the adoption of AI technologies in the healthcare sector.
